reading: People are being forced to leave Pakistan and Iran for Afghanistan.
Some people have never been to Afghanistan.
Nazia was born in Pakistan and crossed the border with her children.
Aid groups offer families a place to stay for a short time.
Some families have little money and no way to earn more.
They need help as they return and start a new life.

vocabulary.definition: made to do something they did not choose
say that someone can have something
get money for work that you do

entries.ja: 選びたくなかったことを、させられた。

entries.es: Obligado a hacer algo que no eligió.
entries.pt-BR: Ser obrigado a fazer algo que não escolheu.
A linha que separa dois países.
